hook.name: UniswapStockLaunchpadFeeHook
hook.description: A flat-fee hook for Uniswap v4 pools on the Long launchpad. In afterSwap, it deducts a configurable fee (0–7% in basis points) from the unspecified currency and accumulates it for the registered fee recipient (the coin's creator), who can claim accrued fees at any time via a permissionless claim function.
